latest_release.name: v53.1.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- Remove the fixed max width of the presenter notes panel  -  by @Lorite and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2766 [<samp>(dad64)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/dad645b9)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Keep c#, c++ and f# languages in code blocks and magic move  -  by @NgoQuocViet2001 in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2760 [<samp>(73053)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/73053ab2)
- Update comark to v0.4.0 to work with markdown-it v15  -  by @Devehab in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2796 [<samp>(f72d6)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/f72d606e)
- Keep v-drag source range when the block ends the slide  -  by @MurzNN and @cursoragent in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2808 [<samp>(827c5)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/827c529c)
- Avoid title-renderer HMR full-reload on body-only edits  -  by @MurzNN and @cursoragent in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2785 [<samp>(9d1cd)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/9d1cddae)
- Unquote font family names in webfont provider URLs  -  by @giaBaoJS in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2749 [<samp>(3b1dc)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/3b1dcdbb)
- **client**:
  - Keep view-transition mode when only clicks change  -  by @RTRowe in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2815 [<samp>(50da4)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/50da4e98)
  - Hide drawing toolbar item in context menu when drawings are disabled  -  by @lazerg in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2801 [<samp>(a0f9f)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/a0f9feb1)
  - Auto-scroll presenter notes on click in builds  -  by @aldesantis and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2772 [<samp>(71a0f)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/71a0f7e3)
- **export**:
  - Create the output directory for every format  -  by @stn1slv in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2745 [<samp>(f77d3)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/f77d30ed)
- **parser**:
  - Ignore a leading UTF-8 BOM  -  by @b84330808 and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/issues/2802 [<samp>(13a9f)</samp>](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/commit/13a9f4aa)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/slidevjs/slidev/compare/v53.0.0...v53.1.0)
